# Geelooy Marketplace & Peruta Mission

From Awtsmoos every vessel is renewed in ordered light;
Awtsmoos.com should make each tool and game discoverable, useful, and bright.

## Outcome
Create a coherent mobile-first product platform across Geelooy: professional catalog presentation, polished shared UI, transparent Peruta commerce, product credits/entitlements where appropriate, and measurable activation/retention/purchase flows.

## Observed Reality
- `apps/wallet` already has modular commerce, ownership, purchase, pricing, ledger and responsive UI modules.
- `games/scripts/storefront` already has contract, model, orchestration and presentation layers.
- `games/scripts/wallet-rewards` already has claim contracts, idempotent-looking key factories, transport and presentation layers.
- `games/scripts/catalog` already has `commerce-plan.mjs`, `marketing.mjs`, capability modules and card markup.

## Strategy
Extend existing shared contracts first. Avoid bespoke payment buttons in dozens of products. Use catalog metadata and reusable commerce surfaces so one platform improvement can reach many apps and games.
